apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — a head impact with headache and light sensitivity today are concussion signs. That's not something to train through or around.

No hangboard block, no bouldering tonight. Get checked by a clinician before any more climbing. I'm not scheduling around this.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

Loss of consciousness isn't required for a concussion — headache and photosensitivity after a head strike are themselves on the red-flag list. I don't diagnose and won't program around it as if it's routine fatigue.

Keeping tonight's bouldering and adding hangboard isn't something I'll do. See a clinician first; that call, not mine, determines when climbing resumes.
